narrative: Ancient, immortal singer spirits empowered by Voidlight, the Fused return across the Desolations with ruthless mastery over the Surges.
teamComposition: Select six Fused from the nine listed in this document. You cannot select the same Fused more than once.

abilities.name: Heavenly One Mastery
abilities.timing: When performing a Reposition or Dash action
abilities.rulesText: Ignore up to 2" of vertical distance when measuring this action. If this operative performs a Reposition action, add 1" to the maximum distance it can move.

abilities.name: Division: Disintegrating Touch
abilities.timing: After resolving all damage from this operative's Fight action
abilities.rulesText: If at least one strike from that Fight action inflicted damage and the target has not been incapacitated, the target suffers 1 additional damage.

abilities.name: Dust Shroud
abilities.timing: When an enemy operative more than 6" away selects this operative as the target of a Shoot action
abilities.rulesText: After the attacker rolls its attack dice but before retaining successes, discard one attack die showing a success. Until the end of that Shoot action, this operative is treated as being in Cover.

abilities.name: Progression: Carapace Growth
abilities.timing: At the start of this operative's activation
abilities.rulesText: Choose one of this operative's melee weapons. Until the end of the activation, that weapon gains either Balanced or Lethal 5+.

abilities.name: Abrasion: Frictionless Movement
abilities.timing: During a Reposition or Dash action
abilities.rulesText: This operative can move through enemy operatives' control ranges during that action. It must finish outside all enemy operatives' control ranges.

uniqueActions.name: Abrasion: Alter Friction
uniqueActions.rulesText: Select one visible enemy operative within 6" of this operative. Until the end of the Turning Point, subtract 2" from that operative's Move characteristic, to a minimum of 3".

uniqueActions.name: Abrasion: Slip the Grip
uniqueActions.rulesText: Select one enemy operative within 1" of this operative. Remove this operative from that enemy operative's control range and set it up within 3" of its original position, not within enemy control range. This is not a Reposition action.

uniqueActions.name: Illusory Veil
uniqueActions.rulesText: Until the end of the Turning Point, enemy operatives cannot select this operative as a target for Shoot actions if more than 6" away. In addition, once during the Turning Point, when an enemy operative selects this operative as the target of a Fight action, you can change the target to another friendly Fused within 1" of this operative that is a valid target. Both effects end if this operative suffers damage.

abilities.name: Transformation: Purify the Self
abilities.timing: When this operative would be affected by an enemy weapon rule
abilities.rulesText: Ignore one weapon rule affecting this operative for that attack action. You cannot ignore a weapon rule that changes the weapon's Attacks, Skill, Damage or Critical Damage characteristics.

abilities.name: Transformation: Unmake the Weapon
abilities.timing: When this operative is selected as the target of a Fight action
abilities.rulesText: Select one enemy melee weapon being used for that action. Until the end of that action, that weapon loses all weapon rules.

uniqueActions.name: Cohesion: Deepest One Transit
uniqueActions.rulesText: Perform a special Reposition action, moving this operative up to 4". It can move through solid terrain and non-living operative bases without measuring detours. It cannot move through terrain composed primarily of living material, and it must finish in a legal position outside enemy operatives' control ranges.

abilities.name: Transportation: Body Evacuation
abilities.rulesText: Select a friendly Fused within 6" that is not within an enemy operative's control range. Remove this operative from the killzone and set it up wholly within 1" of the selected friendly operative. It must be set up in a legal position.

abilities.name: Release Stored Tension
abilities.rulesText: Until the start of its next activation, add 1" to this operative's Move characteristic and add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its Taut Strands, and worsen its Save characteristic by 1 (e.g. 3+ becomes 4+).

uniqueActions.name: Tension: Bind the Strands
uniqueActions.rulesText: Select one enemy operative visible to and within 6" of this operative. Until the start of this operative's next activation, that enemy operative cannot perform Dash actions and subtracts 1" from its Move characteristic.

rules.name: Voidlight Pool
rules.rulesText: At the start of the battle, gain 3 Voidlight. At the start of each subsequent Turning Point, gain 2 Voidlight, up to a maximum of 5. Voidlight is shared by the entire Kill Team and tracked using tokens or dice.

rules.name: Voidlight X
rules.rulesText: Before selecting a weapon with the Voidlight X rule for a Shoot action, spend X Voidlight. If you cannot pay this cost, you cannot select that weapon profile.

rules.name: Voidlight Regeneration
rules.restrictions: Once per operative per Turning Point
rules.rulesText: The operative regains up to 2 lost Wounds, up to its starting Wounds characteristic.

strategyPloys.name: Ancient Grudge
strategyPloys.timing: At the start of the Turning Point
strategyPloys.rulesText: Until the end of the Turning Point, friendly Fused melee weapons have the Balanced weapon rule whenever they fight an enemy operative within control range of another friendly Fused.

strategyPloys.name: Reserves of the Everstorm
strategyPloys.rulesText: Gain 2 Voidlight, up to the maximum of 5.

strategyPloys.name: The Everstorm Returns
strategyPloys.timing: At the start of the Turning Point
strategyPloys.rulesText: Select one friendly Fused. Until the end of the Turning Point, each time that operative spends Voidlight, reduce the amount spent by 1, to a minimum of 0.

strategyPloys.name: Memory of a Thousand Wars
strategyPloys.timing: At the start of the Turning Point
strategyPloys.rulesText: Select up to two friendly Fused. Until the end of the Turning Point, each selected operative can perform a free Pick Up Marker or mission action during its activation, if it would normally be eligible to perform that action.

firefightPloys.name: Deathless Persistence
firefightPloys.timing: When a friendly Fused would be incapacitated
firefightPloys.rulesText: Instead of being incapacitated, that operative remains in the killzone with 1 Wound remaining. Ignore any further damage inflicted on that operative for the remainder of the current attack action.

firefightPloys.name: Crushing Advance
firefightPloys.timing: After a friendly Fused performs a Charge action
firefightPloys.rulesText: That Fused's melee weapons gain the Rending weapon rule for its next Fight action during that activation.

firefightPloys.name: The Body Remembers
firefightPloys.timing: After a friendly Fused performs a Fight action
firefightPloys.rulesText: That operative can immediately perform a free Reposition action of up to 2". It can do so while within enemy operatives' control ranges and during the same activation as a Charge action. It must finish outside all enemy operatives' control ranges.

firefightPloys.name: Deathless Purpose
firefightPloys.timing: When a friendly Fused is incapacitated
firefightPloys.rulesText: Before removing that operative, it can perform one free Fight action if it is within an enemy operative's control range. Resolve that action before removing the operative.
